colorblind-simulator.title: Color Blindness Simulator Pro
colorblind-simulator.intro: A professional color vision deficiency (CVD) simulator. It models 8 vision types in real time — protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia and blue-cone monochromacy — and transforms a single color, an entire palette or an uploaded image. Includes a WCAG 2.1 contrast checker, a CIE Delta-E confusion matrix and color-blind-safe palette suggestions. Everything runs locally in your browser; images are never uploaded.

palette-cvd-checker.title: Palette Color Vision Distinguishability Checker - ToolBox
palette-cvd-checker.intro: Paste a palette and instantly see how well its colors separate under 8 vision channels — normal, red/green and blue/yellow deficiencies, achromatopsia and grayscale. Get a pairwise ΔE matrix, red-flagged confusion pairs, a lightness-ladder score and one-click fixes. All computed locally in your browser.

cvd-safe-palette.title: Colorblind-Safe Palette Generator - ToolBox
cvd-safe-palette.intro: Generate palettes that stay clearly distinguishable across 8 types of color vision, with sequential / diverging / qualitative modes, color locking, a lightness-alternation strategy, live 8-type previews and WCAG 2.1 checks — exported as HEX, CSS variables or JSON.

farnsworth-d15-test.title: Farnsworth D-15 Color Arrangement Test - ToolBox
farnsworth-d15-test.intro: A browser implementation of the classic Farnsworth Panel D-15: arrange 15 equal-lightness caps into a smooth hue sequence, then get a CIE u′v′ polar hue-trace plot, Total Error Score, confusion index and protan/deutan/tritan classification. Runs entirely locally.
